# Libraries
```{r}
library(MOFA2)
```


# Get slide data
```{bash eval=FALSE}
## All colon cancer Prov-GigaPath outputs
wget -r -np -nH -R index.html https://u24-cancer-genomics.seandavi.workers.dev/provgigapath/TCGA_COAD/

```

# Load data
```{r}
dir <- "../TCGA_COAD_READ_provgigapath"
# slide names
fnames <- list.files(dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
# participants
participant_ids <- gsub(".csv$", "", basename(fnames)) %>% 
  strsplit(., "-") %>% 
  sapply(., function(x) paste(x[1:3], collapse = "-"))

```

# Import Prov-gigapath Last embedding Layer
```{r embedding_layer_last}
# function to get embedding layer
structure_last <- getEmbeddingLayer(fnames, participant_ids, layer = "last_layer_embed" )
```


# Read Colon Cancer assay with curatedTCGA

```{r}
#------------------------------------------
# 1. Load COAD + READ RNASeq assays
#------------------------------------------
# Load COAD
coad_mae <- curatedTCGAData(
  diseaseCode = "COAD",
  assays = "RNASeq2GeneNorm",
  version = "2.1.1",
  dry.run = FALSE
)

rna_coad <- coad_mae[["COAD_RNASeq2GeneNorm-20160128"]]
```
